runtime_database: MySQL 8.0.42 (local mysqld, unix socket only, skip-networking), database eventuate CHARACTER SET latin1, sql_mode incl. STRICT_TRANS_TABLES

commands.command: javac -d classes -cp "<bootJar BOOT-INF/lib/*>:lib/*" src/persispector/compat/*.java && jar cf lib/persispector-compat.jar -C classes . (plus mvn dependency:copy of junixsocket-mysql/common/native-common 2.10.1; eventuate-tram-in-memory 0.37.0 from Gradle cache)

mysql -uroot -S /tmp/pv18202/mysql.sock -e "CREATE DATABASE eventuate CHARACTER SET latin1; CREATE USER mysqluser... ; GRANT ALL ON eventuate.*" && mysql ... < aws-fargate-terraform/1.initialize-database.sql && mysql ... < aws-fargate-terraform/2.initialize-database.sql && mysql ... < ../output/patches/01-schema-message-partition.sql (applied after C00)
kill <order-service pid> ; mysqladmin -uroot -S /tmp/pv18202/mysql.sock shutdown ; kill <gradle 8.13 daemon pid started by this run> ; rm -rf /tmp/pv18202

patches.description: Database created with latin1 so AWS DDL (VARCHAR(1000) keys) applies on MySQL 8
ALTER TABLE message ADD message_partition SMALLINT (framework-required column absent from AWS DDL)
Out-of-tree auto-configuration jar on loader.path supplying InMemoryMessageConsumer so no Kafka broker is contacted; no application source modified
Launch command with runtime property overrides (port, unix-socket datasource, flyway disabled, SQL tracing)
MySQL config: skip-networking (unix socket only), general log

logs.description: Full order-service run log (Hibernate SQL + JdbcTemplate TRACE)
SHOW CREATE TABLE output for all eventuate tables after applying the AWS init SQL (+ message_partition compat column)
MySQL general query log for the whole run

notes: Only order-service was deployed: all analyzed targets are in the eventuate schema used by order-service (AWS init SQL) or the Order entity. customer-service, order-history-service, api-gateway, Kafka, CDC service, MongoDB and Zipkin were not started (external services / extra ports not permitted, Docker daemon unavailable).

MySQL used unix-socket-only networking (port 0) so the only TCP listener was the application on 127.0.0.1:18202; the JDBC driver connected via junixsocket socket factory. mysqluser switched to mysql_native_password for socket auth without TLS.
The mysqld binary was copied into .persispector-compat/bin to run a private instance outside the system AppArmor profile path; the system MySQL service was not touched.
Flyway disabled (spring.flyway.enabled=false) so the analyzed AWS DDL, not the framework's Flyway DDL, defines the eventuate tables; orders table created by Hibernate generate-ddl.
No application source files were modified; build.gradle unchanged. Runtime data dir retained at application/.persispector-compat/mysql (stopped).
All processes started (order-service, private mysqld, one Gradle daemon) were stopped; port 18202 released.
